_meta.description: chain_id/store_id/branch_uid/store_name/city/address per branch, extracted from the chain XML dumps (KAN-34). The one durable record of each branch's own raw address/city, since dumps/ itself is gitignored and not kept - used by the geocoding scripts (all three passes) and by scripts/geocode_cheapersal_fill.py's per-chain report.
